_why: Write It Do It B 2027 rules facts (sections 2-4) the corpus cannot supply; the rules manual is the authority for the event.

scoring-beyond-an-error: Teach Write It Do It rule 4.b-4.c from the 2027 rules source: each individual piece receives points as applicable for proper size, color, location, orientation and/or connection; pieces connected correctly beyond an incorrect connection still count; there is no penalty for parts that were not used. Remove any mathematical-sequence content. Draw the consequences for the writer (anchor each piece to a named, already-placed piece) and the builder (keep building after a doubtful step).
ambiguous-steps: Cite rule 4.c from the 2027 rules source: pieces connected correctly beyond an incorrect connection still count in the score, so a builder facing an unclear step should make a best guess and keep going.
time-in-the-build: Cite the 2027 rules source: the builder has twenty (20) minutes (3.d), and time for the construction phase is used as a tiebreaker (4.e). Every piece scores on the same properties (4.b); do not claim some pieces are worth more.
